description: Automatically applies your own settings template to .vscode/settings.json in every folder you open.
cmd.chooseTemplateFile: Use a settings.json file as template…
config.template:
Your settings template. Every key/value here is written to `.vscode/settings.json` of each opened folder. Edit it in your **user** `settings.json`, e.g.

```json
"settingsAutopilot.template": {
    "editor.tabSize": 4,
    "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true
}
```

Ignored if `#settingsAutopilot.templateFile#` is set.
config.templateFile: Optional: path to a `settings.json` file used as template instead of `#settingsAutopilot.template#`. Supports `~` and `${env:VAR}`. Changes to the file are applied to all open folders automatically.
config.enabled: Automatically apply the template when a folder is opened.
config.mode.merge: Merge the template into the existing .vscode/settings.json. Template values win, all other project settings are kept.
config.mode.onlyIfMissing: Only create .vscode/settings.json if the project doesn't have one yet.
config.excludeFolders: Folder names or absolute paths that should **not** be touched.
config.showNotifications: Show a short status bar message after settings were applied.
